reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "[ecs] Add option to keep only healthy ECS tasks (#8027 by Michampt)", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: An optional feature to filter ECS tasks by health status is added; existing configurations without this option continue to work unchanged

proposed.statement: Traefik 3.0.0 adds an optional ECS provider feature to filter and keep only healthy ECS tasks.
